name: agentmesh
description: Deterministic microservices for AI coding agents: AST patching, sub-second microVM sandboxes, test bisection, call-graph indexing, and security guardrails.
author: s6pa1rta3n-lab

tools.name: symbol_graph_build_call_graph
tools.description: Build deep AST call-graph hierarchy for a root function/struct across monorepos without reading raw files.

tools.name: ast_patcher_apply_patch
tools.description: Surgically apply AST node replacement guaranteeing zero syntax regressions.

tools.name: sandbox_pool_create
tools.description: Fork a 3.4ms Copy-on-Write microVM execution container to test speculative edits safely.

tools.name: test_oracle_analyze_impact
tools.description: Compute test impact matrix to run only affected unit tests after a code change.

tools.name: episodic_memory_store
tools.description: Store cross-session architectural learnings, past debugging solutions, and repo patterns.
